name: AI VP Bot
tagline: A second-in-command that keeps multi-platform AI work on time and budget
description: Acts as the deputy when work is spread across several AI services: it holds the project record everyone works from, checks that each handoff actually happened, and pushes back when a task is eating more hours or budget than it should. Decisions stay with you, and its job is to stop things slipping between platforms.
author: JimStansbury5
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
